answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so b1 is not actionable. Circuit breaking would fail writes and threatens settlement value at daily peak, so it is rejected despite b4. The live symptom is write-path saturation (p99 5x, heavy settlement writes), which matches absorbing a surge with headroom (b3) and, if the primary is mixed-load bound, the write-latency recovery from offloading reads (b5). Verifying those two archives to check whether capacity can land in-incident versus only pre-peak, and whether replica offload actually protects writes. Intended action is add_capacity so customer writes continue; failover remains unchosen until records show capacity cannot restore the write path in time. Uncertainty preserved: cause may be the new patch making writes more expensive rather than raw traffic shape.
